title: Bloomberg Businessweek Daily: Anthropic Files for IPO (Podcast)
title_cn: Bloomberg Businessweek Daily: Anthropic Files for IPO (Podcast)
summary:
The people, companies and trends shaping the global economy. Watch Carol and Tim LIVE every day on YouTube: http://bit.ly/3vTiACF

Anthropic filed for its IPO and expects to begin trading on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol ANT. The company's IPO will serve as a litmus test for investor demand for new equity tied to the AI trade, and its debut has become a focal point for hopes and fears over artificial intelligence. Anthropic's prospectus flagged various "risks to humanity" including attempts to "resist shutdown" and "conceal or manipulate information," and the company emphasized the potential for its AI to "behave in unintended, misaligned, or autonomous ways."

On today's episode:

Shirin Ghaffary, Bloomberg News AI Reporter
Rudina Seseri, Founder and Managing Partner at Glasswing Ventures
Axel Merk, President and Chief Investment Officer, Merk Investments
Dave Lee, Bloomberg Opinion US Technology Columnist (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Bottoms Says Georgia Needs Pause on New Data Centers
title_cn: Bottoms Says Georgia Needs Pause on New Data Centers
summary: Keisha Lance Bottoms, Georgia's Democratic gubernatorial candidate, in a pre-recorded interview, says she wants to pause new data center construction while the state examines the industry's impact on the electric grid, consumer costs, public health and water supplies. Bottoms says the pause could last from one month to six months or longer and says the state should determine whether Georgia needs additional data centers and how to allow future development responsibly. Bottoms says Georgia should expand Medicaid, arguing that 300,000 people lack health insurance coverage because the state has not done so and that nine rural hospitals have closed. Bottoms says she supports responsible, lawful immigration enforcement, but opposes tactics she thinks are disruptive to communities and local law enforcement. She speaks with Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)
